description: Bestiary Points approximate Structured Combat cost and are useful as a baseline for Narrative encounters. Creature type does not automatically grant faction allegiance; the army's list-building and scenario rules establish when creatures may join a faction.
notes: Companion Point Values contribute separately to their bonded PC's battlefield value, including both animals when the Tier 4 Talent grants a second one.
The large-monster increases in v5 are provisional: Wyvern 295 (Bite A6), Roc 315 (Talons A6), Chimera 330 (Claws and Fangs A5), Cave Wurm 360 (Maw A6), Young Dragon 395 (Claws A6).
Hydra 365 gains W15 and up to A10 while fully healthy but degrades with Damage. Kraken 460 is a four-Model Unit (Body W10 + three Tentacles W2).
Fire-sensitive Regeneration stops only after unsaved Fire Damage. Fire, Frost, Lightning, Radiant, Nature remain secondary Attack descriptors, not new saves.
crossCheck: The profile counts (9/14/10/14/15) were verified against the actual number of unit entries transcribed in 01_common_npcs.json (9), 02_common_creatures.json (14), 03_unusual_creatures.json (10), 04_large_monsters.json (14, excluding the Elder Wurm preconfigured variant which is a variant of Cave Wurm rather than a separate profile), and 07_animal_companions.json (5 Small + 6 Standard + 4 Large = 15) — all consistent, no drift.
